### Host switcher reliability

- Fixed an issue where reopening the host switcher after a successful selection left every host option disabled.
- The host list and interaction state now refresh whenever the global shortcut opens the switcher.
- The fix applies to both Windows and macOS, including the case where the currently active host is selected again.

### macOS window behavior

- Clicking the Dock icon now restores and focuses the main DisplayMux window after it has been hidden with the red close button.
- DisplayMux continues running in the background when the main window is closed, so global shortcuts and the local agent remain available.

### Compatibility

- Supports Windows 10/11 and macOS 12 or later.
- Existing settings are preserved when updating from v0.1.6.

### Known limitations

- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed but not notarized with an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper may require manual approval.
- Some MST, DisplayLink, and Silicon Motion docks do not forward DDC/CI. Software cannot restore control signals that the hardware does not expose.
